We were somewhere near the doomed edge of the savage desert when the brutal fear and loathing took hold, and I knew then that we were dealing with a truly atavistic and monstrous kind of bad craziness.

The swine were everywhere. Vicious, degenerate swine, wallowing in their own depraved and decadent filth, and the whole thing was doomed from the start. Savage. Brutal. Monstrous.

I told my attorney that this was gonzo, pure and simple, the most atavistic display of swine behavior I had witnessed since the doomed and savage days. He agreed. The bad craziness was upon us and there was no turning back from the whole thing.

Fear and loathing. Depraved, decadent, vicious, degenerate, doomed. That is the only honest way to describe these monstrous and atavistic swine.
